nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ and every real $\delta > 0$ there are a positive integer $q$ and an integer $p$ with $|x - p/q| < \delta/2$.
nodes.title: Every real number has arbitrarily close rationals

nodes.summary: For every real $s \le 0$, the density $\eta_{\log}$ of the logarithmic smallest denominator satisfies $\eta_{\log}(s) = \frac{6}{\pi^2} e^{2s}$.
nodes.title: The log smallest-denominator density for nonpositive arguments

nodes.summary: The density $\eta_{\log}$ of the logarithmic smallest denominator satisfies $\eta_{\log}(0) = 6/\pi^2$.
nodes.title: Value of the log smallest-denominator density at zero

nodes.summary: The function $\eta_{\log}$ on the real line is defined by $\eta_{\log}(s) = \frac{6}{\pi^2} e^{2s}$ for $s \le 0$, by $\eta_{\log}(s) = \frac{6}{\pi^2}\left(-e^{2s} + 2 + 4s\right)$ for $0 < s \le \log 2$, and by
nodes.title: Density of the logarithmic smallest denominator

nodes.summary: Let $x$ and $\delta$ be real numbers and let $q$ be a positive integer with $q < q_{\min}(x, \delta)$, where $q_{\min}(x, \delta)$ is the smallest denominator. Then there is no integer $p$ with $|x - p/q| < \delta/2$.
nodes.title: Minimality of the smallest denominator

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ and every real $\delta > 1$, the smallest denominator $q_{\min}(x, \delta)$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Wide intervals have smallest denominator one

nodes.summary: Let $x$ be a real number, let $\delta > 0$ be real, let $q$ be a natural number and let $q_{\min}(x, \delta)$ be the smallest denominator. Then $q_{\min}(x, \delta) \le q$ if and only if there are a positive integer $q' \le q$ and an integer $p$ with $|x - p/q'| < \delta/2$.
nodes.title: Upper bounds on the smallest denominator

nodes.summary: Let $x$ and $\delta$ be real numbers, let $q$ be a positive integer and let $p$ be an integer. If $|x - p/q| < \delta/2$, then the smallest denominator satisfies $q_{\min}(x, \delta) \le q$.
nodes.title: Denominators of nearby rationals bound the smallest denominator

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ and every real $\delta > 0$, the smallest denominator $q = q_{\min}(x, \delta)$ is positive and there is an integer $p$ with $|x - p/q| < \delta/2$.
nodes.title: The smallest denominator is positive and attained

nodes.summary: For real numbers $x$ and $\delta$, the smallest denominator $q_{\min}(x, \delta)$ is the least positive integer $q$ for which there is an integer $p$ with $|x - p/q| < \delta/2$, that is, with $p/q$ in the open interval $(x - \delta/2, x + \delta/2)$. If there is no such $q$, which happens only when $\delta \le 0$, then $q_{\min}(x, \delta) = 0$.
nodes.title: Smallest denominator in an interval

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
